clips.title: 鲁比尼：经济不依赖美联储政策
title_lines: 鲁比尼：经济不依赖美联储政策
科技革命推动美国潜在增速翻倍至4%
AI等12大产业爆发，市场回报可期
title_highlights: 经济不依赖美联储政策

subtitles.en: Norea Rabinia for Rabinia macros associates writing on this trajectory, UX exceptionalism, strengthens rather than fade, equity valuations need not rest on bubble dynamics
subtitles.zh: 诺瑞亚·鲁比尼在鲁比尼宏观协会撰文指出，美国例外论趋势正在加强而非消退，权益资产估值无需依赖泡沫，

subtitles.en: and should deliver solid returns despite episodic volatility.
subtitles.zh: 尽管市场偶有波动，仍应带来稳健回报。

subtitles.en: Norea, join us now for more. Norea, good morning. Good morning.
subtitles.zh: 诺瑞亚，欢迎加入我们。早上好。早上好。

subtitles.en: Really beautiful moment with Senator David McCormick leaving the studio you come again and he said, you're no longer a doctor, do many more, you're a doctor, boom.
subtitles.zh: 参议员大卫·麦考密克离开演播室时说了句精彩的话：你不再是博士了，你是博士，砰。

subtitles.en: What's changed? What change has been essentially the most important technological innovation in human history?
subtitles.zh: 什么变了？本质上，人类历史上最重要的技术创新是什么？

subtitles.en: While everybody is talking about AI and Genie, this is only one of the 12 or more industries of the future.
subtitles.zh: 大家都在谈论AI和生成式AI，但这只是未来12个以上行业之一。

subtitles.en: You have AI, you have semiconductors, you have robotic automation and human robots, you have fusion energy, you have quantum, you have defense tech, you have space exploration,
subtitles.zh: 有AI、半导体、机器人自动化、人形机器人、聚变能源、量子、国防科技、太空探索，

subtitles.en: fintech, architect, you have new material science, new cryptography, really is a cambrian explosion of innovations.
subtitles.zh: 金融科技、架构、新材料科学、新密码学，这真是一场创新的寒武纪大爆发。

subtitles.en: Each one of them has to say powered by AI but they're separate verticals, very separate indices, space exploration, exploitation is separate from AI, even if it's
subtitles.zh: 每一个都由AI驱动，但它们是独立的垂直领域，太空探索与AI不同，即使AI为其提供支持。

subtitles.en: fed by AI. So I'm going to see US potential growth for the last two decades has been barely 2%.
subtitles.zh: 因此，我认为美国过去二十年的潜在增长率仅为2%左右。

subtitles.en: I expected that by the end of these decades it's going to be at least 4%.
subtitles.zh: 我预计到本十年末，利率至少会达到4%。

subtitles.en: And the data already suggests that productivity since COVID has doubled in spite of COVID, it's already closer to 2% plus and with potential growth higher,
subtitles.zh: 数据已经显示，疫情后生产率翻倍，接近2%以上，潜在增长更高。

subtitles.en: there'll be a significant increase also in equity market returns.
subtitles.zh: 权益市场回报也将显著增加。

subtitles.en: How concerned are you about pumps along the way?
subtitles.zh: 您对过程中的波动有多担心？
